title: Time of "sensor expired" is only for English speakers ok
symptom: The sensor expiry message shows time in AM/PM format instead of 24-hour format, which is confusing for non-English users and does not follow the phone's 24-hour clock setting.
cause: xDrip did not honor the Android system setting for 24-hour time format when displaying the sensor expiry note.
fix: Fixed as of the 2025.12.10 release. xDrip will follow the Android setting for the 24-hour format; if enabled, the sensor expiry note will be shown in that format.
evidence_quote: This is fixed as of the 2025.12.10 release. xDrip will follow your Android setting for the 24-hour format. If you have enabled that setting in Android, xDrip will show the sensor expiry note in that format.
